computation: Every irreducible component of the proper incidence dominates the normal dual projective space. In its Stein factorization the finite generic fiber is geometrically connected, so its reduced algebra is one purely inseparable field extension; its degree need not be one. Every component of the finite Stein factor dominates the base, hence its reduction is integral. Over a normal affine base A, each element b of the finite reduced algebra has a p-power in Frac(A), and that power is integral, hence lies in A. Thus the reduced Stein factor is finite radicial and surjective, a universal homeomorphism. Nilpotents do not alter connectedness, and the Stein fibers are geometrically connected, so all original fibers are geometrically connected. In characteristic zero the purely inseparable extension is trivial. This is a present-run proof, retaining the source’s properness and component hypotheses.

statement: The converse claiming that equivalence of bounded locally constant derived categories over every fixed nonzero coefficient ring detects weak homotopy equivalence is false. Over Q it detects only rational cohomological information once the local systems are fixed.

Over Q its two-cell differential is multiplication by p, hence invertible. All Q-local systems are constant and their positive Ext groups are the rational cohomology of X with Hom coefficients, which vanishes. Bounded Postnikov induction therefore gives D^b_lc(X;Q)≃D^b(Q). Taking the face category of a finite triangulation gives the category-nerve formulation.
fate: Negative for the stated fixed arbitrary nonzero coefficient ring. Hatcher Example2.40 supplies the precise Moore-space construction; the derived-category deduction and rational cellular computation are independently checked here. statement: For a locally split exact sequence 0→E′→E→E″→0 with E′ finite locally free of rank n, the chart of rank-n quotients restricting to an isomorphism on E′ is the sheaf of retractions E→E′.
